title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 2: made alive when dead in sins, saved by grace through faith, the middle wall broken down, and fellow citizens built into a temple.

questions.text: In what state were the readers when they were made alive, according to the first verse?
questions.explanation: It says they were made alive when they were dead in transgressions and sins.

questions.text: According to whom does the chapter say they once walked?
questions.explanation: It says they once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

answers.text: According to the traditions of their fathers
According to the teachers of the law
According to the rulers of the city
According to the prince of the power of the air

questions.text: How is God described where the chapter turns from their old way of life?
questions.explanation: It says that God is rich in mercy, because of his great love with which he loved us.

answers.text: A judge of all the nations

questions.text: Why does the chapter say salvation is not of works?
questions.explanation: It says they have been saved by grace through faith, and that this is not of themselves but the gift of God, not of works, so that no one would boast.

answers.text: So that the law may still be kept
So that the Gentiles may be included
So that no one would boast
So that the saints may be rewarded

questions.text: What does the chapter call us, created in Christ Jesus for good works?
questions.explanation: It says we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

questions.text: How does the chapter describe their former position toward Israel and the covenants?
questions.explanation: It says they were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

answers.text: Alienated from the commonwealth of Israel
Counted among the children of Abraham
Under the tutor of the law like Israel
Already near through the blood of the covenant

questions.text: What does the chapter say he broke down, being our peace?
questions.explanation: It says he is our peace, who made both one and broke down the middle wall of separation.

questions.text: To whom does the chapter say he came and preached peace?
questions.explanation: It says he came and preached peace to those who were far off and to those who were near.

answers.text: Only to those who were already near
Only to the household of God in Israel
To those who were far off and to those who were near
To the principalities and the powers

questions.text: What does the chapter say they are, now that they are no longer strangers and foreigners?
questions.explanation: It says they are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God.

answers.text: Servants in the courts of the temple
Heirs of the commonwealth of Israel

questions.text: Who is called the chief cornerstone of the building?
questions.explanation: It says they are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone.
